name: Swarmkeeper
description: A ranger subclass that adds the Swarmkeeper tradition from Tasha's Cauldron of Everything.

grants.name: Gathered Swarm
grants.description: Once per turn after you hit, your swarm either deals 1d6 Piercing damage, moves the target up to 15 feet after a Strength save, or moves you 5 feet without provoking Opportunity Attacks.

grants.name: Swarmkeeper Magic
grants.description: Learn Mage Hand and additional Swarmkeeper spells as your Ranger level increases. Your Mage Hand appears as part of your swarm.

grants.name: Writhing Tide
grants.description: As a Bonus Action, gain a 10-foot Fly Speed and Hover for 1 minute. Uses equal your Proficiency Bonus per Long Rest.

grants.name: Mighty Swarm
grants.description: Gathered Swarm's damage becomes 1d8; its forced movement can knock the target Prone, and its self-movement grants Half Cover until your next turn.

grants.name: Swarming Dispersal
grants.description: When you take damage, use your Reaction to gain Resistance to that damage and teleport up to 30 feet. Uses equal your Proficiency Bonus per Long Rest.
